recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a browser-native mobile portrait game titled "Haddonfield Last Porch Light". Preserve the source mechanics: immediate play, touch/pointer target-follow movement, spawning timed objects that become collectible, +10 score on collision with ripe/active objects, life loss when active objects expire, five lives to game over, and restart. Reframe the world as Halloween slasher survival: a flashlight-carrying babysitter moves through a foggy suburban autumn street, collecting lit clues/porch lights before a silent white-masked stalker cuts them out. Use procedural canvas art for houses, road, orange moon, fog, leaves, glowing clues, red failure marks, survivor, and distant mask silhouette. Keep HUD readable and tappable in portrait 4:7 to 9:16.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

Source truth: the old game is a single-canvas mobile arcade survival collection game. It starts directly in PLAYING, uses pointerdown/pointermove on the canvas to move a hero by smooth target-follow interpolation, spawns timed objects, advances them through GROWING/RIPE/ROTTING states, scores +10 on collision with ripe objects, subtracts one life when a ripe object expires, and shows a restartable game-over overlay at zero lives.

Protected mechanics: target-follow input, spawn cadence config, growth/ripe/rot timing constants, collision radii, +10 score semantics, five-life failure semantics, immediate start, restart button, particles/GIF/SFX as feedback only.

Remix blueprint: reinterpret the crop harvest as Haddonfield clue/porch-light rescue. The player is a flashlight-carrying babysitter; timed objects are clues that become safe to collect when lit; missed clues are porch lights cut by the Shape; the game over state is being found. Presentation is rebuilt as a procedural autumn suburb in a single inline index.html.

identity.identity: A mobile-first slasher survival collection game set on a foggy Haddonfield street where porch lights are disappearing.
